approach: Independent bid and ask fees. A trade of at least 0.50% of post-trade Y reserves widens the opposite side by 135 bps, capped at base plus two bumps. Both sides start at 30 bps; excess fees decay by 7 bps per elapsed observed step. This protects the side a return arbitrage would use while leaving the other side open to retail flow.
